name: Aurelia Strappy Heel
desc: A slim gold heel with crossed straps and a buckled ankle. Made for weddings, year-end functions and every long dinner in between.

name: Blush Satin Block Mule
desc: Soft satin on a steady block heel. Slips on in a second and stays comfortable on grass, paving and dance floors.

name: Midnight Court Heel
desc: The pointed court heel that works with everything, in a deep navy suede that reads softer than black.

name: Karoo Ankle Boot
desc: A clean tan ankle boot on a low stacked heel, for cool Highveld mornings and winter weekends away.

name: Lagoon Ring T-Strap
desc: A cool blue T-strap sandal with a tonal ring detail and a soft textured footbed. Rinses clean after a day at the beach.

name: Sahara Slingback Sandal
desc: Sand-toned slingback with a slim bronze strap that sits diagonally across the foot. Easy to dress up or down.

name: Noir Twist T-Strap
desc: A black T-strap sandal with a soft pewter twist through the toe post. The everyday pair that goes with most of your wardrobe.

name: Onyx Ring Thong
desc: Crossed black straps finished with gold studs and a polished ring. A flat sandal that looks like it took more effort than it did.

name: Savanna Leopard Flip-Flop
desc: A leopard print footbed with metallic bronze straps. A small bit of fun for poolside, patio and the school run.

name: Gilt Band Thong
desc: A black flat sandal with one wide gold band across the toes. Simple and easy to wear from breakfast to sundowners.

name: Rose Dune Flip-Flop
desc: A soft cream footbed with braided rose gold straps, made for sand, salt air and slow walks at sunset.

name: Cognac Penny Loafer
desc: A hand-finished look in warm cognac leather. Wear it with a linen suit in summer and with chinos the rest of the year.

name: Harbour Suede Sneaker
desc: A clean navy suede sneaker on a crisp white sole. Smart enough for dinner and easy enough for the weekend.

name: Oak Two-Strap Sandal
desc: Two wide leather straps on a contoured footbed, in a dark brown that only gets better with wear.

name: Breeze Linen Wrap Dress
desc: A true wrap dress in breathable linen, cut to midi length with short sleeves. It ties to fit and stays cool through the heat of the day.

name: Champagne Slip Skirt
desc: A bias cut satin skirt that moves when you do. Pair it with a white shirt by day or the Aurelia heel by night.

name: Blush Tailored Blazer
desc: The soft pink blazer that sharpens a dress, a pair of jeans or a work day. Single breasted with a clean line.

name: Sky Linen Shirt
desc: A relaxed long sleeve linen shirt in pale blue. Roll the sleeves and wear it open at the collar when the heat sets in.

name: Midnight Tailored Chino
desc: Neat navy chinos with a tailored leg, sharp enough for the office and comfortable enough for everything after it.

name: Ecru Knit Polo
desc: A fine knit polo in soft ecru. It does what a T-shirt does, but looks considered with very little effort.

name: Blush Top-Handle Bag
desc: A small structured bag with a gold clasp. Big enough for your phone, keys and lipstick, and neat enough for the whole evening.

name: Golden Hoop Earrings
desc: Chunky polished hoops with a warm gold finish. The one piece of jewellery that finishes almost any outfit.

name: Silk Twill Scarf
desc: An abstract navy, blush and gold print on a soft twill. Wear it in your hair, around your neck or tied to a bag handle.

name: Cognac Leather Belt
desc: A slim dress belt with a brushed gold buckle, in the same warm cognac as our penny loafer.

name: Tortoise Sunglasses
desc: Classic tortoiseshell frames with gold hinges. They suit most face shapes and live happily in a shirt pocket.

name: Midnight Card Holder
desc: A slim grained leather card holder in deep navy, for the days you would rather not carry a wallet.
details: Slim enough for a front pocket
